rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_unconstrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.3516, n_angles=128, n_det=1024, det_spacing=0.35754, sod=500.0, sdd=1000.0, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.5, train_n=400, val_n=200, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=16, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=0.1, fd_recon_dc=0, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, rationale=iter-8: DC-off breast-prior. Switch lever to STEPS (NFE). Hold near-best init_t=0.4, eta=0.1 (eta plateaued: iter-6 eta0.2 PSNR28.1, iter-7 eta0.05 PSNR28.5 - diminishing, so eta~0.1 is the practical floor). ONE KNOB steps 8->16. PRIOR: eta sweep found lower=better but flattening; init_t optimum ~0.4. HYPOTHESIS: doubling Euler steps 8->16 gives finer flow-ODE integration -> the prior denoises the FBP-init more accurately -> PSNR edges up. NOTE eta=0.1 is a small config move vs iter-7's 0.05 but the PRIMARY knob is steps; eta 0.05->0.1 is within the plateaued flat region (rounding to a stable midpoint), so steps remains the interpretable single lever. Best PSNR so far 28.5 is still 7.8dB under the 128-view FBP baseline (36.3) - hr=0 firmly, as expected for DC-off.
